ux_users_email_active.name: ux_users_email_active
ux_users_email_active.where: "users"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "users"."email" IS NOT NULL

ck_users_auth.name: ck_users_auth
ck_users_auth.value: "users"."password_hash" IS NOT NULL OR "users"."pin_hash" IS NOT NULL

ck_menu_items_price_consistency.name: ck_menu_items_price_consistency
ck_menu_items_price_consistency.value:
("menu_items"."price_type" = 'fixed' AND "menu_items"."price_fixed" IS NOT NULL AND "menu_items"."price_hot" IS NULL AND "menu_items"."price_iced" IS NULL)
        OR ("menu_items"."price_type" = 'variant' AND "menu_items"."price_fixed" IS NULL AND ("menu_items"."price_hot" IS NOT NULL OR "menu_items"."price_iced" IS NOT NULL))
        OR ("menu_items"."price_type" = 'open' AND "menu_items"."price_fixed" IS NULL AND "menu_items"."price_hot" IS NULL AND "menu_items"."price_iced" IS NULL)

ck_menu_items_price_nonneg.name: ck_menu_items_price_nonneg
ck_menu_items_price_nonneg.value:
("menu_items"."price_fixed" IS NULL OR "menu_items"."price_fixed" >= 0)
        AND ("menu_items"."price_hot" IS NULL OR "menu_items"."price_hot" >= 0)
        AND ("menu_items"."price_iced" IS NULL OR "menu_items"."price_iced" >= 0)

ck_shifts_settlements_nonneg.name: ck_shifts_settlements_nonneg
ck_shifts_settlements_nonneg.value:
("shifts"."edc_settlement" IS NULL OR "shifts"."edc_settlement" >= 0)
        AND ("shifts"."gofood_settlement" IS NULL OR "shifts"."gofood_settlement" >= 0)
        AND ("shifts"."grabfood_settlement" IS NULL OR "shifts"."grabfood_settlement" >= 0)
        AND ("shifts"."shopeefood_settlement" IS NULL OR "shifts"."shopeefood_settlement" >= 0)

ck_shifts_close_consistency.name: ck_shifts_close_consistency
ck_shifts_close_consistency.value:
("shifts"."status" = 'closed' AND "shifts"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("shifts"."status" = 'open' AND "shifts"."closed_at" IS NULL)

ck_transactions_cash_fields.name: ck_transactions_cash_fields
ck_transactions_cash_fields.value:
("transactions"."payment_method" = 'cash' AND "transactions"."cash_received" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("transactions"."payment_method" = 'split' AND "transactions"."cash_received" IS NULL AND "transactions"."cash_change" IS NULL)
        OR ("transactions"."payment_method" NOT IN ('cash', 'split') AND "transactions"."cash_received" IS NULL AND "transactions"."cash_change" IS NULL)

ck_transaction_corrections_split_consist.name: ck_transaction_corrections_split_consistency
ck_transaction_corrections_split_consist.value:
("transaction_corrections"."corrected_payment_method" = 'split' AND "transaction_corrections"."corrected_split_breakdown" IS NOT NULL)
       OR ("transaction_corrections"."corrected_payment_method" != 'split' AND "transaction_corrections"."corrected_split_breakdown" IS NULL)

ux_recipes_menu_variant_set.name: ux_recipes_menu_variant_set
ux_recipes_menu_variant_set.where: "recipes"."menu_item_id" IS NOT NULL AND "recipes"."variant" IS NOT NULL

ux_recipes_menu_no_variant.name: ux_recipes_menu_no_variant
ux_recipes_menu_no_variant.where: "recipes"."menu_item_id" IS NOT NULL AND "recipes"."variant" IS NULL

ck_recipes_target_xor.name: ck_recipes_target_xor
ck_recipes_target_xor.value:
("recipes"."menu_item_id" IS NOT NULL AND "recipes"."ingredient_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("recipes"."menu_item_id" IS NULL AND "recipes"."ingredient_id" IS NOT NULL)

ck_approval_codes_consumed_pair.name: ck_approval_codes_consumed_pair
ck_approval_codes_consumed_pair.value: ("approval_codes"."consumed_at" IS NULL AND "approval_codes"."consumed_by_user_id" IS NULL) OR ("approval_codes"."consumed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "approval_codes"."consumed_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL)

ck_approval_codes_revoked_pair.name: ck_approval_codes_revoked_pair
ck_approval_codes_revoked_pair.value: ("approval_codes"."revoked_at" IS NULL AND "approval_codes"."revoked_by_user_id" IS NULL) OR ("approval_codes"."revoked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "approval_codes"."revoked_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL)

ck_approval_codes_target_xor.name: ck_approval_codes_target_xor
ck_approval_codes_target_xor.value:
("approval_codes"."action_type" IN ('pos.transaction.void','pos.transaction.refund')
            AND "approval_codes"."target_transaction_id" IS NOT NULL
            AND "approval_codes"."target_shift_rebalance_id" IS NULL
            AND "approval_codes"."target_transaction_correction_id" IS NULL
            AND "approval_codes"."target_entry_change_id" IS NULL)
       OR ("approval_codes"."action_type" = 'shift.rebalance'
            AND "approval_codes"."target_shift_rebalance_id" IS NOT NULL
            AND "approval_codes"."target_transaction_id" IS NULL
            AND "approval_codes"."target_transaction_correction_id" IS NULL
            AND "approval_codes"."target_entry_change_id" IS NULL)
       OR ("approval_codes"."action_type" = 'pos.transaction.correction'
            AND "approval_codes"."target_transaction_correction_id" IS NOT NULL
            AND "approval_codes"."target_transaction_id" IS NULL
            AND "approval_codes"."target_shift_rebalance_id" IS NULL
            AND "approval_codes"."target_entry_change_id" IS NULL)
       OR ("approval_codes"."action_type" = 'entry_change'
            AND "approval_codes"."target_entry_change_id" IS NOT NULL
            AND "approval_codes"."target_transaction_id" IS NULL
            AND "approval_codes"."target_shift_rebalance_id" IS NULL
            AND "approval_codes"."target_transaction_correction_id" IS NULL)

ck_split_payments_cash_fields.name: ck_split_payments_cash_fields
ck_split_payments_cash_fields.value:
("split_payments"."payment_method" = 'cash' AND "split_payments"."cash_received" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("split_payments"."payment_method" <> 'cash' AND "split_payments"."cash_received" IS NULL AND "split_payments"."cash_change" IS NULL)

ux_employees_user_active.name: ux_employees_user_active
ux_employees_user_active.where: "employees"."user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "employees"."deleted_at" IS NULL

ux_employees_employee_number_outlet.name: ux_employees_employee_number_outlet
ux_employees_employee_number_outlet.where: "employees"."employee_number" IS NOT NULL AND "employees"."deleted_at" IS NULL

ck_attendance_minutes_nonneg.name: ck_attendance_minutes_nonneg
ck_attendance_minutes_nonneg.value:
("attendance_records"."late_minutes" IS NULL OR "attendance_records"."late_minutes" >= 0)
        AND ("attendance_records"."overtime_minutes" IS NULL OR "attendance_records"."overtime_minutes" >= 0)
        AND ("attendance_records"."work_minutes" IS NULL OR "attendance_records"."work_minutes" >= 0)

ck_schedules_times_consistency.name: ck_schedules_times_consistency
ck_schedules_times_consistency.value:
("employee_schedules"."day_off" = true AND "employee_schedules"."start_time" IS NULL AND "employee_schedules"."end_time" IS NULL)
        OR ("employee_schedules"."day_off" = false AND "employee_schedules"."start_time" IS NOT NULL AND "employee_schedules"."end_time" IS NOT NULL)

ck_payroll_lines_money_nonneg.name: ck_payroll_lines_money_nonneg
ck_payroll_lines_money_nonneg.value:
"payroll_lines"."base_salary" >= 0
        AND "payroll_lines"."overtime_pay" >= 0
        AND "payroll_lines"."late_deduction" >= 0
        AND "payroll_lines"."bonus" >= 0
        AND "payroll_lines"."thr" >= 0
        AND "payroll_lines"."advance_deduction" >= 0
        AND "payroll_lines"."other_deductions" >= 0

ck_promos_date_range.name: ck_promos_date_range
ck_promos_date_range.value: "promos"."start_date" IS NULL OR "promos"."end_date" IS NULL OR "promos"."start_date" <= "promos"."end_date"

ck_cash_deposits_verified_consistency.name: ck_cash_deposits_verified_consistency
ck_cash_deposits_verified_consistency.value:
("cash_deposits"."status" = 'verified' AND "cash_deposits"."verified_by" IS NOT NULL AND "cash_deposits"."verified_at" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("cash_deposits"."status" = 'rejected' AND "cash_deposits"."rejected_reason" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("cash_deposits"."status" = 'pending_verification' AND "cash_deposits"."verified_by" IS NULL AND "cash_deposits"."verified_at" IS NULL AND "cash_deposits"."rejected_reason" IS NULL)

ck_journal_retry_terminal_xor.name: ck_journal_retry_terminal_xor
ck_journal_retry_terminal_xor.value: NOT ("journal_retry_queue"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "journal_retry_queue"."abandoned_at" IS NOT NULL)

ck_journal_retry_resolved_pair.name: ck_journal_retry_resolved_pair
ck_journal_retry_resolved_pair.value: ("journal_retry_queue"."resolved_at" IS NULL AND "journal_retry_queue"."resolved_by_user_id" IS NULL) OR ("journal_retry_queue"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "journal_retry_queue"."resolved_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL)

ck_journal_retry_abandoned_pair.name: ck_journal_retry_abandoned_pair
ck_journal_retry_abandoned_pair.value:
("journal_retry_queue"."abandoned_at" IS NULL AND "journal_retry_queue"."abandoned_by_user_id" IS NULL AND "journal_retry_queue"."abandoned_reason" IS NULL)
       OR ("journal_retry_queue"."abandoned_at" IS NOT NULL AND "journal_retry_queue"."abandoned_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("journal_retry_queue"."abandoned_reason")) >= 3)

ck_employee_advances_resolve_consistency.name: ck_employee_advances_resolve_consistency
ck_employee_advances_resolve_consistency.value:
("employee_advances"."status" = 'pending' AND "employee_advances"."resolved_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("employee_advances"."status" != 'pending' AND "employee_advances"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL)

ck_hist_daily_summary_nonneg.name: ck_hist_daily_summary_nonneg
ck_hist_daily_summary_nonneg.value:
"historical_daily_summary"."gross_revenue" >= 0
        AND "historical_daily_summary"."total_refund" >= 0
        AND "historical_daily_summary"."total_void" >= 0
        AND "historical_daily_summary"."total_discount" >= 0
        AND "historical_daily_summary"."net_revenue" >= 0
        AND "historical_daily_summary"."transaction_count" >= 0
        AND "historical_daily_summary"."cogs" >= 0

ux_investors_outlet_nik.name: ux_investors_outlet_nik
ux_investors_outlet_nik.where: "investors"."nik" IS NOT NULL AND "investors"."deleted_at" IS NULL

ux_investors_outlet_email.name: ux_investors_outlet_email
ux_investors_outlet_email.where: "investors"."email" IS NOT NULL AND "investors"."deleted_at" IS NULL

ck_distribution_v2_fields_consistent.name: ck_distribution_v2_fields_consistent
ck_distribution_v2_fields_consistent.value: "profit_distributions"."calculation_model" = 'v1' OR ("profit_distributions"."payout_ratio_pct" IS NOT NULL AND "profit_distributions"."loss_rate_snapshot" IS NOT NULL AND "profit_distributions"."capex_rate_snapshot" IS NOT NULL)

ux_creditors_outlet_nik.name: ux_creditors_outlet_nik
ux_creditors_outlet_nik.where: "creditors"."nik" IS NOT NULL AND "creditors"."deleted_at" IS NULL

ck_share_tx_kind_shape.name: ck_share_tx_kind_shape
ck_share_tx_kind_shape.value:
("share_transactions"."kind" = 'p2p_transfer'
          AND "share_transactions"."from_investor_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "share_transactions"."to_investor_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "share_transactions"."amount_idr" = 0
          AND "share_transactions"."bank_account_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("share_transactions"."kind" = 'company_buyback'
          AND "share_transactions"."from_investor_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "share_transactions"."to_investor_id" IS NULL
          AND "share_transactions"."amount_idr" > 0
          AND "share_transactions"."bank_account_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("share_transactions"."kind" IN ('top_up', 'initial')
          AND "share_transactions"."from_investor_id" IS NULL
          AND "share_transactions"."to_investor_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "share_transactions"."amount_idr" > 0
          AND "share_transactions"."bank_account_id" IS NOT NULL)
